scope: Fresh input arrays + findStep exact technique in one isolated warm Node worker; compute includes input validation, detector and explanation payload. Independent DLX semantic proof is outside timed region. Node request roundtrip is not the production browser Worker budget.
statistics: Nearest-rank empirical p50/p95/p99, each call measured individually in milliseconds. These are observed distributions for selected boards, not population or device guarantees. No batching/division. Errors and watchdog timeouts are never misses and never silently dropped.

correctness.scope: Every phase-three exact-technique detector on every supplied genuine state. Original puzzle uniqueness, placed values, candidate legality and solution retention rechecked independently. Every emitted effect proven by independent Algorithm X counterexample search, not merely compared with one solution. Logical elimination history is not replayed.
correctness.oracle: Independent Algorithm X / dancing links, maximum 2,000,000 nodes per query. Budget exhaustion is inconclusive and recorded as an error, never accepted as proof.
